      "name": "ipc",

      "evidence": "Touches src/interfaces/mining.h only mechanically to update callers to validation error return types, not IPC infrastructure.",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical caller updates across interfaces do not make this an IPC PR."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Introduces src/kernel/fatal_error.h, touches src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp, and removes INTERNAL_ERROR from the kernel C API.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Refactors kernel error reporting by cleanly distinguishing fatal runtime failures from validation state at the library boundary. It improves kernel API boundary hygiene without addressing an urgent bug or adding net-new API capabilities."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/validation.cpp concern block validation error reporting and chainstate methods rather than mempool policy or limits.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter mempool acceptance, policy, or fee estimation logic."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to src/node/miner.cpp and src/rpc/mining.cpp are downstream adjustments to altered validation method return types.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not affect block template construction or mining mechanics."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,

      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "P2P network handling and protocol behavior are unaffected."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifications to RPC files are mechanical updates adapting to the new util::Expected return types.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter RPC endpoints, schemas, or RPC infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to test files are unit and fuzz tests being updated to match the new validation APIs rather than changes to testing harnesses or framework.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Updating test callers to match modified validation signatures does not constitute test framework work."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "src/bitcoin-chainstate.cpp is updated solely as a consumer of modified validation/kernel methods.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not a change to tool features or standalone developer tooling."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Validation label, alters src/validation.cpp, src/validation.h, and src/consensus/validation.h, and changes major validation functions like ConnectBlock and ActivateBestChain.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Retires a long-standing architectural hazard where runtime system errors were conflated with consensus and policy invalidity in BlockValidationState. As noted in the description, non-validating functions such as FlushStateToDisk, InvalidateBlock, and ActivateBestChain took validation out-parameters purely for error reporting, and this refactoring untangles runtime failures from block validity while unblocking further validation decoupling (#35570)."
    },
